$comment: The indoor party's band (marimba), owner's ruling 2026-11-07. Sheet stage only: the instrument lives in the sheet's words because the rig has no instrument props yet, and motion.set is a placeholder that only supplies a skeleton to override, until the band-loop set in plan/levels/indoor-band-2026-11-07.md exists. Do not plan frames from this set.
description: Indoor party band, marimba: long-armed, narrow man of about forty, big round black afro, round gold-rimmed spectacles.
traits: long-armed, narrow man of about forty, big round black afro, round gold-rimmed spectacles
demeanor: the quiet one: absorbed in the bars, head nodding

garments.text: closed cream shirt with a small midnight-violet bow tie
long-sleeved cream dinner jacket with narrow midnight-violet lapels
polished two-tone cream and dark shoes

drawing.fits: the whole of his afro, both shoes, both hands, both mallets and the whole marimba
drawing.look: tall, narrow, long-armed adult build, long thin lined face, neatly trimmed short beard flecked with grey, round gold-rimmed spectacles, focused gentle smile, brown skin, big perfectly round black afro, long-sleeved cream dinner jacket buttoned closed, its narrow midnight-violet satin lapels lying flat on the chest, a small midnight-violet bow tie at a closed cream shirt collar, slim dark charcoal trousers and polished two-tone cream and dark shoes, and thick dark ink outline, behind a compact wooden marimba with a row of warm rosewood bars at his waist and a row of brass resonator tubes hanging beneath them, on a dark frame with two end legs
drawing.extra: He is a grown man of about forty. He holds two separate short mallets, one in each hand, each as long as his forearm with a round cream head. The hand on the left of the picture holds its mallet straight up beside his shoulder, with the round head in the air by his ear. The hand on the right of the picture points its mallet down, with the round head on a bar. The marimba stands between him and the viewer, about as wide as he is tall: its row of bars crosses in front of his belt and covers his hips, and its brass tubes hang in front of his thighs, with his shins and both shoes showing below them.

front.description: standing square facing the viewer behind the marimba, feet apart, elbows out, looking down at the bars, the hand on the left of the picture lifted to shoulder height and the hand on the right of the picture low over the bars
